evidence_boundary: Independent portfolio estimand specification for public CDISC pilot data. It is not a sponsor-approved estimand, protocol amendment, SAP approval or regulatory position.

estimands.objective: Compare each active treatment with placebo on ACTOT change from baseline at Week 24 while retaining observed outcomes after treatment discontinuation.

treatment.assignment_rule: Use planned randomised treatment assignment for efficacy grouping; retain TRT01A separately as actual-treatment context when planned and actual treatment differ.

population.description: Portfolio analysis population operationalised as randomised subjects with an observed baseline ACTOT score.

variable.direction: Lower ACTOT change is treated as more favourable in this portfolio analysis.

intercurrent_events.operational_rule: Retain observed Week 8, Week 16 and Week 24 ACTOT measurements regardless of recorded treatment discontinuation.

primary.assumption_note: Likelihood-based inference uses observed post-baseline ACTOT values. MAR is an estimator assumption and is not an estimand attribute.

supportive_sensitivity.limitation: LOCF is not the primary estimator and is not presented as preferred missing-data handling under ICH E9(R1).

portfolio_input_limitations: Treatment discontinuation is the only intercurrent event operationalised in this estimand review because it is explicitly represented in the current DS-derived subject data.
Rescue medication, treatment switching and other potential intercurrent events are not inferred when they are not explicitly available in the current portfolio inputs.

The public pilot data contain planned-versus-actual treatment mismatches. v0.23 controls efficacy missing-data sensitivity grouping by planned randomised assignment and preserves actual treatment as contextual provenance.
